'''Cipher Three''' was the codename of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] agent who went rogue. He was the father of [[Raina Temple]], and his daughter hunted him down and [[Death/Legends|killed]] him before the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] could.
